no_adcom_quote.quote: No Advisory Committee Meeting was held. There were no new issues raised in the review of the application which were thought to benefit from an Advisory Committee Meeting.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the XIIDRA (lifitegrast) NDA208073 approval. The Summary Review and Cross-Discipline Team Leader review both state that no Advisory Committee Meeting was held because no new issues arose that would benefit from one, and the Division Director memo notes there were no efficacy or safety issues warranting an AC discussion. There are therefore no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
